items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Joins class names and resolves Tailwind conflicts, with the Cadence density scale registered.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message that stands out from the page. A status carries its fill, border, icon and word, never colour alone.
items.docs: An Alert is announced when it appears. For a message that is on the page from the start, set role. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A dialog that must be answered: confirming an action that stops, removes or cannot be undone. Focus lands on the safe answer.
items.docs: Put AlertDialogCancel first in the footer, so focus lands on it. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: Application shell
items.description: The frame of an application, as shadcn's sidebar-16 lays it out: a header across the top, and a sidebar beside the content below it. It starts with a link that skips to the content.
items.docs: Put AppShellHeader first, then AppShellBody holding AppShellSidebar and AppShellContent. The header's first button opens the sidebar. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label or count. A status variant carries its fill, text and border tokens.
items.docs: A status badge's text must say what the status is. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Sized by the density set on the page.
items.docs: Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month of days to choose from, on react-day-picker. Each day is as tall as a control, and today and unavailable days are marked by more than colour.
items.docs: Pass a locale from react-day-picker/locale, such as enAU, for the week to start on the right day. Cadence grades what it renders, not react-day-picker. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Groups related content on its own surface, with a header, content and footer.
items.docs: Give CardTitle a heading level with render={<h2 />}. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A choice that is on, off or partly on. Its target is as large as a control.
items.docs: Wrap each Checkbox in a Label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One section that opens and closes. The trigger says whether it is open, and the section grows to its height in 150ms, without motion under reduced motion.
items.docs: Render CollapsibleTrigger as a Button. Set hiddenUntilFound on CollapsibleContent so the browser's find can open it. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Renders a TanStack table: sorting, selection, paging and column visibility, with the state in words as well as marks.
items.docs: Pass dataTableFeatures to useTable, and name the table with aria-label. Cadence grades what it renders, not TanStack Table. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A window over the page for one task. It holds focus, is never taller than the screen, and its scrim darkens the page in both modes.
items.docs: Give every Dialog a DialogTitle: it is the dialog's name. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel from an edge of the screen that can be swiped away, most often from the bottom of a phone. What does not fit scrolls inside it.
items.docs: Give every drawer a DrawerTitle, and keep a DrawerClose in it: a screen reader on a touch screen cannot swipe. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A list of actions that opens from a trigger. Each item is as high as a control, a checked item carries a tick, and a long item wraps.
items.docs: A menu does things. To hold a choice, use a Select. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: What a list or a panel shows when it has nothing in it: what is empty, and what to do next. Its spacing follows the density.
items.docs: Say what is empty, not what it means: an empty list is not a finding. Render EmptyTitle as a heading where the panel has one. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: One control with its label, description and error, tied together so none of it is wired by hand.
items.docs: Put one control in each Field. Render FieldError only while the value is wrong. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A group of fields with one error summary. A failed attempt to send lists every problem at the top, each linked to its field, and moves focus there.
items.docs: Put a FormErrorSummary first in the Form and a Field around each control: the summary reads each Field's error. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text input. Sized by the density set on the page.
items.docs: Give every Input a Label or an aria-label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of media, a title and a description, and actions. Its text wraps and is never cut short.
items.docs: For a list, render ItemGroup as a ul and each Item as an li. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Names a control. Its text follows the density set on the page.
items.docs: Point htmlFor at the control's id. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A line of muted text that marks a place in a list or a page, plain, between two rules or over one. A long label wraps between its rules.
items.docs: Where a Marker heads what follows, render it as a heading. In a list, render it as an li. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel that opens from a trigger and leaves the page in reach. It never outgrows the room it has.
items.docs: Give every Popover a PopoverTitle, or an aria-label on PopoverContent. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a few, all visible at once.
items.docs: Name the group, and wrap each item in a Label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One choice from a list that opens below the field. A long value wraps and is never truncated.
items.docs: Pass items to Select so the field shows an option's label, and give SelectTrigger a Label or an aria-label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A rule between two groups of content, announced as a separator.
items.docs: Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel from an edge of the screen, for a task beside the page. It slides in from its edge, scrolls what does not fit, and its title clears the close button.
items.docs: Give every sheet a SheetTitle. Render SheetTrigger and SheetClose as a Button through render. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible application navigation. Its items follow the density, the shown item is marked by shape as well as fill, and on a phone it is a sheet over the page.
items.docs: Wrap the layout in SidebarProvider, with the Sidebar and a SidebarInset beside it. Mark the page shown with isActive. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Holds the place of content that is loading, in the shape it will take. It shows on every surface in every brand and mode, and is hidden from assistive technology.
items.docs: Mark the region that is loading aria-busy, and say in words what is loading. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Chooses a setting from a range, by pointer or keyboard. The whole strip is a target as high as a control, the track can be seen at 3:1, and each thumb of a range has its own name.
items.docs: Use a Slider for a setting, not a clinical value, which is typed. Name each thumb of a range with thumbLabels. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Shows that something is in progress. It fades instead of turning under reduced motion.
items.docs: Pass aria-hidden when text beside it already says what is happening. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off, and the change applies at once.
items.docs: Wrap the Switch in a Label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A table of data. Cells wrap between words, a word is never broken, and a table that is too wide scrolls inside its own focusable box.
items.docs: Name every Table with a TableCaption, an aria-label or aria-labelledby. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Views of one subject, one shown at a time. Tabs that do not fit wrap, and none is clipped.
items.docs: Give each TabsTrigger and its TabsContent the same value. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input that grows with what is typed.
items.docs: Give every Textarea a Label or an aria-label, or put it in a Field. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short message that something happened, announced to a screen reader. Each type has its own outline, and a toast is never the only place an error is shown.
items.docs: Put Toaster once around the app and call toast.add. A toast goes away, so show an error where it happened too. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed. Pressed is a fill and a boundary, never colour alone.
items.docs: With iconOnly, keep the label as the toggle's text. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A set of toggles that belong together, spaced or joined into one segmented control.
items.docs: Give every ToggleGroup an aria-label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint shown when its trigger is hovered or focused. Never the only place something is said.
items.docs: A tooltip does not open on a touch screen and is not announced by a screen reader, so its trigger needs its own name. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: typeset
items.title: Typeset
items.description: Styles plain HTML inside a typeset container: rendered markdown, patient information and clinical notes.
items.docs: Wrap content in an element with the typeset class. Cadence grades the stylesheet it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.
